question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Periodic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Irregular.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Periodic"** means something that occurs at regular intervals or is recurring at a consistent time period. (नियत समयान्तराल पर होने वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** The periodic maintenance of the machinery ensures its smooth operation.
 
 
 
• **"Irregular"** refers to something that does not occur at regular intervals or lacks a consistent pattern. (अनियमित)
 
 
• **Example:** His attendance in class was irregular, often missing several days in a row.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Periodic'** is **'Irregular'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Holistic** (समग्र): Considering something as a whole rather than just its parts.

 
 
• **Example:** A holistic approach to education considers the emotional and social development of students in addition to their academic progress.
 
 
 
• **Dynamic** (गतिशील): Characterized by constant change, activity, or progress.
 
 
• **Example:** The dynamic nature of the tech industry requires professionals to continually update their skills.
 
 
 
• **Tedious** (नीरस): Too long, slow, or dull; tiresome or monotonous.
 
 
• **Example:** The tedious task of data entry made the hours drag on.
